FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How is a solution different from custom software?

A solution starts from foundations we have already built for that kind of system, such as ERP or CRM. That shortens delivery while still letting us tailor it fully to your business.

How much can a solution be customised?

Fields, workflows, roles, reports, branding and integrations are all adapted to how your business works.

Can a solution connect to our existing systems?

Yes. We integrate with accounting, payment, CRM, ERP and other tools through APIs.

Can we start small?

Yes. Many clients begin with the modules that matter most and add more in planned phases.

Let's find the right solution for your business

Tell us which processes you want to improve. We'll suggest where to start and what a first release could include.
